title: Ordinary exchange on homotopy single-module comparisons
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S and p:X′→X be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme] with pf=f′g. Assume tensor pullback along g and p is additive. Let M be an X-module, F=f_*, G=tensorPullback g, H=tensorPullback p, I=f′_*, and t_p:H≅p* the unique adjunction-preserving comparison [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let E=M[0] in the homotopy category. Write s_J for the canonical isomorphism J(M[0])≅(JM)[0] for an additive functor J, and Q for the homotopy quotient. Put a=Q(s_F⁻¹), b=Q(s_H) followed by t_p(M)[0], c=Q(s_G), d=Q(s_I⁻¹) at p*M, and k=B_M followed by I(t_p(M)), where B is ordinary module exchange [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction]. Then Gh(a) followed by the homotopy exchange b_E [lem-pc-derived-base-change-unit-compatibility] followed by Ih(b) equals c followed by k[0] followed by d. This is an equality of homotopy-category maps and assumes no flatness, acyclicity or derived category.

source.place: Tag 08HY, ordinary exchange and termwise functoriality

proof.text: Prove the exchange identity for four arbitrary additive functors on categories with zero objects. Postcompose with the hom single-map comparison for I, apply HomologicalComplex.to_single_hom_ext, and simplify the degree-zero maps. Map this chain-map equality through the homotopy quotient. The definitions of mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso and NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory identify this with the generic homotopy equation. Specialize to the moduleBaseChangeMap natural transformation and the adjunction-preserving tensor-pullback comparison. All helpers are proved, and no new sorry is used.

theorem homotopySingleBaseChangeComparison
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (p : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : p ≫ f = f' ≫ g) (M : X.Modules)
    [(tensorPullback g).Additive] [(tensorPullback p).Additive] :
  let C_X := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
  let C_S := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)
  let C_X' := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)
  let C_S' := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)
  let E := (HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor C_X 0).obj M
  let F : C_X ⥤
      C_S :=
    RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom
  let G : C_S ⥤
      C_S' := tensorPullback g
  let H : C_X ⥤
      C_X' := tensorPullback p
  let I : C_X' ⥤
      C_S' :=
    RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f'.toLRSHom.toShHom
  let _ : F.Additive := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage_additive_proof f.toLRSHom.toShHom
  let _ : I.Additive := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage_additive_proof f'.toLRSHom.toShHom
  let t_p := (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction p)).leftAdjointUniq
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p)
  let a := (HomotopyCategory.quotient C_S (.up ℤ)).map
    ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex F (.up ℤ) 0).inv.app M)
  let b := (HomotopyCategory.quotient C_X' (.up ℤ)).map
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex H (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app M) ≫
    (HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor C_X' 0).map (t_p.hom.app M)
  let c := (HomotopyCategory.quotient C_S' (.up ℤ)).map
    ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex G (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app (F.obj M))
  let d := (HomotopyCategory.quotient C_S' (.up ℤ)).map
    ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex I (.up ℤ) 0).inv.app
      ((pullback p).obj M))
  let k := moduleBaseChangeMap f f' g p h M ≫ I.map (t_p.hom.app M)
  (G.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map a ≫
      (moduleHomotopyBaseChange f f' g p h).app E ≫
      (I.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map b =
    c ≫ (HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor C_S' 0).map k ≫ d
